about: Visa rules for Indian ordinary passport holders, summarised from research on 16 October 2026. Each record links its sources. Rules change often.

visaKeys.OT: Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visa

records.name: Brunei
records.rule: Visa required. Apply before travel at the Brunei High Commission in New Delhi (single entry, about B$20, 30 days).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Indonesia
records.rule: e-VOA or visa on arrival, 30 days, about IDR 500,000.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Vietnam
records.rule: e-visa, up to 90 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Cambodia
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 30 days, about US$36.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Laos
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 30 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Sri Lanka
records.rule: Free ETA or visa on arrival, 30 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Maldives
records.rule: Visa-free, 90 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bangladesh
records.rule: Visa required in advance, no visa on arrival. Government fee waived for Indians, small service charge. Tourist visa issuance was reported paused in early 2026 and resuming in October 2026, so confirm it is open. The Ministry of External Affairs has a standing advisory against travel there.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bhutan
records.rule: No visa, but an entry permit (free, online or at the border) and a Sustainable Development Fee of INR 1,200 per person per night, fixed to Aug 2027.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Oman
records.rule: Visa required. 14-day visa on arrival only with a valid US, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan or Schengen visa; otherwise e-visa. Needs return ticket, hotel booking and health insurance.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bahrain
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 14 days; on arrival for holders of a valid UAE, UK, US, Saudi or Schengen visa.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Saudi Arabia
records.rule: India is not on the official tourist e-visa list. An e-visa or visa on arrival is for holders of a valid US, UK or Schengen visa; otherwise embassy visa or the package-visa pilot (about SAR 4,000 minimum). Sources disagree, so confirm before planning.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Jordan
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 30 days. The Jordan Pass waives the visa fee only for a stay of 2 or more nights.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Kazakhstan
records.rule: Visa-free, 14 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Kyrgyzstan
records.rule: e-visa, up to 60 days. Expect an invitation-letter step after applying.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Uzbekistan
records.rule: 30 days visa-free only with a valid multiple-entry visa from the US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan or South Korea and an onward air ticket (rule from 1 Sep 2026); the stay must fall within that visa. Otherwise e-visa, about US$25 for one month.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Azerbaijan
records.rule: e-visa, 30 days (airport kiosk about US$30; prior e-visa for land borders).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Armenia
records.rule: e-visa, 90 days; visa on arrival with a valid visa from the EU/Schengen, US, UK, Canada or Japan.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Japan
records.rule: e-visa for people residing in India, tourism, single entry, up to 90 days, through authorised agencies.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Taiwan
records.rule: Visa required, but a free online Travel Authorization Certificate (14 days) is available with a visa or residence card from the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, South Korea or a Schengen state that is valid or expired under 10 years ago.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Philippines
records.rule: Visa-free 14 days for tourism; 30 days with a valid US, Schengen, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan or Singapore visa. Needs hotel booking, proof of funds and an onward ticket.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Switzerland
records.rule: Schengen visa required (one visa covers about 29 countries; multiple entry advised). Apply 3 to 6 months ahead. Entry/Exit System biometric registration is live since 10 Apr 2026.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Liechtenstein
records.rule: Covered by the Schengen visa.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.rule: Schengen visa required.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Serbia
records.rule: Visa-free (90 days in 6 months, within the validity) for holders of a valid Schengen, EU-state, UK or US visa or residence permit.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
records.rule: Visa-free for up to 30 days per stay (90 in 6 months) with a valid multiple-entry Schengen/EU or US visa; otherwise visa required.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Montenegro
records.rule: Visa required, but 30 days visa-free with a valid multiple-entry US, UK, Schengen or Irish visa (secondary sources); the official page only states the visa requirement.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Albania
records.rule: Visa-exempt with a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa that has been used in a Schengen state, or a multiple-entry EU, US or UK visa previously used in the issuing country; otherwise e-visa.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: North Macedonia
records.rule: Visa required. Exempt (15 days per entry, 90 in 180) with a multiple-entry Schengen C sticker visa; a multiple-entry US, UK or Canadian visa also works, but only until 31 Dec 2026 (temporary decision).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Turkey
records.rule: Visa required. A single-entry e-visa valid one month is available with a valid Schengen, US, UK or Irish visa or residence permit.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Finland
records.rule: Schengen visa required.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.rule: Schengen visa required.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Morocco
records.rule: Official e-visa, 30 days (no visa on arrival for Indians).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Andorra
records.rule: No visa regime of its own, but reached via France or Spain, so a double or multiple-entry Schengen visa is needed.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Malta
records.rule: Schengen visa required.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Greece
records.rule: Schengen visa required.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: United Kingdom
records.rule: UK visa required (separate from Schengen); standard visitor fee about GBP 127.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Ireland
records.rule: Irish visa required, or a UK visa endorsed under the British-Irish Visa Scheme if you enter the UK first.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Kenya
records.rule: Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA), up to 90 days; East Africa Tourist Visa also valid.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Tanzania
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 90 days, about US$50.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Rwanda
records.rule: Free 30-day visa on arrival (Commonwealth citizens).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Uganda
records.rule: e-visa required before arrival. The US CDC advised enhanced precautions on 28 Aug 2026 because of an outbreak in the DRC.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Ethiopia
records.rule: e-visa, or visa on arrival at Addis Ababa airport; land borders need an embassy visa. Several governments advise against Amhara and parts of Afar.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Mauritius
records.rule: Visa-free, 90 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Madagascar
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 90 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: South Africa
records.rule: Electronic Travel Authorisation required, about R500, 90 days, valid at OR Tambo, Cape Town and Lanseria airports only.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Lesotho
records.rule: Visa required in advance. The e-visa portal showed "suspended, apply by email" on 16 Oct 2026.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Eswatini
records.rule: Visa required in advance; no visa on arrival.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Zimbabwe
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 1 month.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Zambia
records.rule: e-visa, 90 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Botswana
records.rule: e-visa, up to 3 months.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Namibia
records.rule: Visa required in advance: e-visa, or online visa on arrival at Windhoek and Walvis Bay airports (about NAD 1,600), up to 90 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Seychelles
records.rule: Visa-free via the Electronic Border System; register online about 10 days before flying (about EUR 10.90) with proof of funds and a return ticket.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Egypt
records.rule: e-visa, 30 days, about US$30 single entry; the fee is due to rise on 1 Jan 2027.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Tunisia
records.rule: Visa from the Tunisian embassy before travel; visa-free only for organised groups. No e-visa found.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Australia
records.rule: Visitor visa (subclass 600), online, AUD 250.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: New Zealand
records.rule: Visitor visa plus the NZD 100 International Visitor Levy.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Fiji
records.rule: Visa-free, free visitor permit on arrival, up to 4 months.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Vanuatu
records.rule: Visa-free, 120 days (confirm with Vanuatu immigration).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Samoa
records.rule: Free entry permit on arrival, 60 to 90 days (sources differ, use 60).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bahamas
records.rule: e-visa up to 3 months; visa on arrival or no visa with a valid US, UK, Canada or Schengen visa.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Jamaica
records.rule: Visa-free.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Dominican Republic
records.rule: Visa required, but not if you hold a valid US, Canada or EU-state visa.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Barbados
records.rule: Visa-free, 90 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Trinidad and Tobago
records.rule: Visa-free, 90 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Panama
records.rule: Visa required, but exempt with a valid multiple-entry US, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan, South Korea, Singapore or EU visa that has been used once and has a year left.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Costa Rica
records.rule: Visa required, but exempt with a multiple-entry US visa with at least 6 months of validity left.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Mexico
records.rule: Visa required, but exempt with a valid visa or residence from the US, Canada, Japan, UK or Schengen.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Colombia
records.rule: Visa required, but exempt with a valid Schengen visa, or a US visa with 180 days left.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Ecuador
records.rule: Visa required in advance; no exemption found for US or Schengen holders.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Peru
records.rule: Visa-free up to 180 days with a valid Australia, Canada, UK, US or Schengen visa with 6+ months left.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Argentina
records.rule: Visa required, but visa-free entry (online AVE) for holders of certain US visas or a green card (since 2025).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Brazil
records.rule: Visa required in advance for Indians, even with a US or Schengen visa.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Chile
records.rule: Visa required, but exempt with a US visa (any type except C) with 6+ months of validity left.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.
